svg.title: A closed-folder choice sits beside two equal windows
svg.desc: Hold the cursor over the closed-draft choice beside equally weighted assistant and composite-skeptic windows. The decision remains pending rather than graphically predetermined.

**Frame:** Curt selects the manuscript and hovers over a closed-folder icon. A third window is open beside ChatGPT's, the same size and brightness, in the critique's typeface but with no byline: its title bar reads `SKEPTIC — COMPOSITE`.

**Screen / system text — SKEPTIC (COMPOSITE):**
> If they are malware, this is a hundred pages of anthropomorphizing an indicator list. Publish the indicators. The saga teaches the frame, not the fix.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> We could decide the risk is a reason not to publish.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `invented` — creator dilemma. The skeptic window is a disclosed composite: it carries the publication objection, which no dated writing in the source index makes, and it carries no real person's name. Its malware premise is the [page-039](039.md) critique's; the objection built on it is the project's.

", "title": "A closed-folder choice sits beside two equal windows" } }
